content.value_statement: Production ML systems are hard to design, deploy, monitor, and improve reliably. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code structured ML engineering guidance.
actual_capabilities: Summarizes production ML architecture patterns for deployment, monitoring, scaling, and reliability.
Provides MLOps guidance covering testing, deployment automation, logging, monitoring, and compliance.
Guides LLM integration work across architecture patterns, performance tuning, and troubleshooting topics.
Explains RAG system architecture concepts, configuration practices, deployment strategies, and observability needs.
Includes placeholder Python CLI scaffolds for model deployment, RAG building, and ML monitoring workflows.
limitations: The included Python scripts are scaffolds and do not implement full ML platform behavior.
The skill does not train models, connect to cloud services, or deploy infrastructure by itself.
Security, privacy, and compliance advice must be reviewed against each organization policy.
Performance targets are generic examples and require validation on real workloads.

use_cases.title: Plan A Model Deployment
use_cases.description: Design a production deployment path with serving, monitoring, rollback, and operational readiness checks.

use_cases.title: Review A RAG Architecture
use_cases.description: Assess retrieval, generation, caching, observability, and reliability choices before a RAG system launch.

use_cases.title: Standardize MLOps Practices
use_cases.description: Create team guidance for testing, CI, deployment automation, monitoring, incident response, and model governance.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Deployment Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a production readiness checklist for deploying a machine learning model. Include serving, monitoring, rollback, and security topics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when starting a deployment review.

prompt_templates.title: MLOps Pipeline Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my MLOps pipeline plan for gaps in testing, CI, deployment automation, model monitoring, and retraining triggers.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this before implementing or improving a pipeline.

prompt_templates.title: RAG System Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a RAG system architecture for my product. Cover indexing, retrieval, generation, evaluation, caching, monitoring, and failure handling.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this when planning a retrieval augmented generation system.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Production Incident Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this production ML incident. Identify likely root causes, missing observability, recovery steps, prevention controls, and owner actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use this after a model serving, data quality, or retrieval failure.

output_examples.input: Review our plan to deploy a fraud model behind an API.
output_examples.output: A deployment readiness review covering serving latency, feature validation, canary rollout, monitoring metrics, rollback triggers, and security checks.

output_examples.input: Help us design a support knowledge base RAG system.
output_examples.output: An architecture outline with ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval ranking, answer generation, evaluation, caching, and observability recommendations.

output_examples.input: Create MLOps standards for a growing data science team.
output_examples.output: A team operating guide for experiment tracking, version control, automated tests, deployment approvals, model monitoring, and incident response.

best_practices: Validate model, data, and infrastructure assumptions before deployment decisions.
Keep monitoring, rollback, and incident response plans close to every production change.
Treat LLM and RAG quality as an evaluated production behavior, not a one-time prompt task.
anti_patterns: Do not deploy model changes without measurable acceptance criteria and rollback triggers.
Do not treat placeholder scripts as complete production automation.
Do not send sensitive data to LLM or retrieval systems without approved controls.

faq.question: Does this skill include working ML deployment code?
faq.answer: It includes Python scaffolds, but the files are placeholders. They need implementation before production use.

faq.question: Can it help with RAG system planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides architecture topics for indexing, retrieval, generation, deployment, monitoring, and evaluation.

faq.question: Does it support LLM integration work?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers integration patterns, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and production design concerns.

faq.question: Is it useful for engineering managers?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help define standards, reviews, responsibilities, and operational practices for ML teams.

faq.question: Will it deploy cloud infrastructure automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and example commands, but users must review and run infrastructure actions themselves.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
